meta.description: React + Express + TypeScript + SQLite full-stack app for logging Overwatch 2 matches, a pre-match LLM advisor, a stats/trends dashboard, and an in-house mouse-sensitivity (DPI stage-trial) research study.
meta.generated: architecture snapshot, hand-derived from source at analysis time

nodes.label: App.tsx
nodes.description: Root component. Owns dark/light theme toggle, wraps everything in Hero/Map/Match/MatchEdit drawer context providers, mounts the router, and globally mounts the drawers + DeathLogger so they can render on top of any page.

nodes.label: React Router
nodes.description: BrowserRouter routes. '/', '/prematch', '/log', '/trends' are aliases that all render Dashboard (those sections now live as tabs inside it). '/sens' and '/sens/analysis' are a separate, intentionally unlinked sensitivity-study area sharing the same backend/DB.

nodes.label: Dashboard.tsx
nodes.description: Main single-page app shell. Renders StatCards (overview/streaks), the rolling win-rate trend, mode comparison, and composes the Prematch, LogMatch and TrendsSummary sections as tabs.

nodes.label: Prematch.tsx
nodes.description: Pre-match prep screen: map picker, LLM tactical advisor (AdvisorCard), map-voting win rates, DPI Stage-Trial Test HUD, session tilt/depth banner, and best-hero-by-hour context.

nodes.label: LogMatch.tsx
nodes.description: Match logging form: hero/role/map/queue-mode/win-loss, in-game sens, 0-100 'feel' slider, freeform notes. Sends no DPI or study flag — the server alone decides whether a match belongs to an active DPI stage-trial.

nodes.label: SensLog.tsx
nodes.description: Sensitivity-study control page: create/cancel DPI stage-trial sets (one per hero + one ad-hoc), poll the guided loop's live state, advance stages, and backfill post-match aim/combat stats from the pending queue.

nodes.label: SensAnalysis.tsx
nodes.description: Sensitivity study results dashboard: accuracy/win-rate by cm/360 scale, hitscan vs. projectile archetype split, cold-vs-warm session position, and adaptation-since-DPI-change effects.

nodes.label: AdvisorCard.tsx
nodes.description: Renders the cached/live LLM recommendation: primary + stretch hero picks and one grounded death-pattern coaching sentence, plus the death-axis spectrum bars.

nodes.label: DeathLogger.tsx
nodes.description: Modal opened after a loss is logged (from MatchContext). Captures per-death factual axis tags (trade/timing/grouping/awareness) on a 0-1 spectrum, written back onto the match's `deaths` JSON column.

nodes.label: DeathInsights.tsx
nodes.description: Shared presentational panel (used by both drawers) rendering a death-tag breakdown: reason %, win/loss correlation per reason, and deaths-per-win vs. deaths-per-loss.

nodes.label: HeroDrawer.tsx
nodes.description: Slide-over drawer with a hero's full profile: overall/momentum win rate, best/worst maps and game types, last 10 results, and DeathInsights for that hero.

nodes.label: MapDrawer.tsx
nodes.description: Slide-over drawer with a map's profile: overall/momentum win rate, best heroes per role, recent results, and DeathInsights for that map.

nodes.label: MatchEditDrawer.tsx
nodes.description: Slide-over editor for a previously logged match: partial field edit (PUT) or delete, then triggers a global revalidate so every page reflects the change.

nodes.label: TrendsSummary.tsx
nodes.description: Draws 4 random one-sentence factoid cards from the server's precomputed insight pool (death-pattern, hot-hand, performance-mismatch, queue-switch tax, crit accuracy, kill-secure rate, best/worst session window).

nodes.label: UI Primitives
nodes.description: Small stateless presentational components reused across pages: stat tiles, animated counters, empty states, queue-mode watermark, page headers, the /sens sub-nav, the odometer readout, and win-rate bars.

nodes.label: MatchContext
nodes.description: Global provider holding the in-progress match form (hero/map/queue mode), fetching the LLM advisor recommendation (GET /api/advisor/recommend), and opening DeathLogger when a loss is logged.

nodes.label: Drawer Contexts
nodes.description: Three small open/close state providers — which hero/map/match is currently open in its slide-over drawer. Pure UI state, no data fetching of their own.

nodes.label: useApi() hook
nodes.description: Generic fetch-and-cache hook every page/component uses to call the Express API. Exposes a global `revalidateAll()` — every mounted useApi subscribes, so one mutation (e.g. logging a match) refreshes the whole app in place.

nodes.label: useHeroCounts / useMapCounts
nodes.description: Today's per-hero and per-map match counts, used to annotate picker options with a '(N) played today' suffix across LogMatch, Prematch, SensLog/Analysis, and both drawers.

nodes.label: lib/aim.ts (client)
nodes.description: Client-side mirror of the server's aim math: MOUSE_DPI constant, eDPI(sens,dpi) and cm360(sens,dpi) — kept in sync by hand with server/src/lib/aim.ts.

nodes.label: index.ts
nodes.description: Express app entry point. Loads server/.env, applies CORS (locked to http://localhost:5173) and JSON body parsing, and mounts all 5 routers under /api/*. Listens on port 3001.

nodes.label: routes/matches.ts
nodes.description: CRUD for logged matches. On POST, the server (not the client) decides whether an active DPI stage-trial set exists for the match's hero (or an ad-hoc set); if so it stamps the stage's DPI onto the match, increments games_on_stage, and auto-retires the set the instant its last stage hits its game target.

nodes.label: routes/stats.ts
nodes.description: The largest router: overview/by-hero/by-map/by-hour/by-day/trends/momentum/weekly/streaks/map-voting/hero-cards/hero-detail/map-detail, plus a family of 'insight' analyses (death-axis vs outcome, hot hand, performance-outcome mismatch, queue-switch tax, crit accuracy, kill-secure rate, best/worst session window) that feed the Trends factoid pool.

nodes.label: routes/advisor.ts
nodes.description: Pre-match tactical recommendation. Picks a data-grounded primary hero (comfort pool x map win rate) and stretch pick, aggregates the player's factual death axes for the map/type/overall scope, and calls Claude Haiku for one coaching sentence — cached 7 days per (map, queue_mode).

nodes.label: routes/aim.ts
nodes.description: Sensitivity-study data plane: the pending-backfill queue (matches with sens logged but no aim_stats yet), upserting per-match combat stats, and /analysis — the full cm/360-bucketed accuracy/win-rate aggregation with cold/warm and adaptation splits.

nodes.label: routes/blind.ts
nodes.description: DPI stage-trial set lifecycle: create (explicit DPI list or auto-generated ±% spread), list, cancel (with a logged-games safety check), live loop state for all concurrently active sets, and advance-to-next-stage. Everything is shown plainly on screen — no hidden/blind mechanic remains.

nodes.label: lib/aim.ts (server)
nodes.description: Aim-math + session derivations: eDPI, cm360, archetypeOf(hero) (hitscan vs. projectile), deriveSessionPosition (cold/warm), deriveSensAdaptation (matches since last sens/DPI change).

nodes.label: lib/blind.ts
nodes.description: Stage-generation helpers for a DPI stage-trial set: generateStages(base, pctRange, n) for an auto ±% spread, or stagesFromDpis(list) for hand-picked DPI values.

nodes.label: db/schema.ts
nodes.description: Single getDb() SQLite (node:sqlite) accessor + all additive migrations (ALTER TABLE guarded by PRAGMA table_info checks, one-time rescales guarded by PRAGMA user_version). Owns WAL mode and foreign keys. Every route reaches the DB only through this module.

nodes.label: matches (table)
nodes.description: One row per logged game: date/time/hero/role/map/game_type/win, queue_mode, sens+dpi, feel (0-100 perceived speed), notes, deaths (JSON, v2/v3 factual axes), and blind_trial/blind_set_id/stage_index linking a match to its DPI stage-trial set.

nodes.label: aim_stats (table)
nodes.description: One-to-one with a match (match_id PK), entered separately at match end: overall_acc, crit_acc, hero_stat, elims/final_blows/deaths/damage/duration_min — the combat-output scoreboard used for performance-outcome analysis.

nodes.label: blind_stage_sets + blind_stages
nodes.description: A DPI stage-trial set (in_game_sens, base_dpi, batch_size, cur_rel/current stage, active flag, optional hero tag) plus its ordered blind_stages rows (stage_index -> dpi). Several sets can be active concurrently, one per hero plus one ad-hoc.

nodes.label: advisor_cache (table)
nodes.description: LLM insight cache keyed by (map, queue_mode), TTL 7 days. Only the coaching sentence + stretch pick are cached — death breakdown and hero stats are always recomputed live so a cache hit still reflects newly logged matches.

nodes.label: Anthropic API (Claude Haiku 4.5)
nodes.description: External LLM call via @anthropic-ai/sdk, structured output (json_schema) constrained to {insight, stretch, stretch_untested}. Requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; the route responds 503 if it's unset.

edges.label: reads selected map/hero, triggers advisor fetch
writes match form state; opens Death Logger on a loss
controls open state + receives death-axis tags
auto-tag DPI from active set; +games_on_stage; auto-retire
comfort pool, death axes, map context

flows.name: Log a Match
flows.description: Player logs a completed match. The server alone decides whether it belongs to an active DPI stage-trial set, silently stamping DPI onto the row and advancing that set's game counter.

steps.label: Player fills hero/role/map/win-loss/sens/feel and submits.
POST /api/matches — looks up an active blind_stage_sets row for this hero (or the ad-hoc slot).
getDb() — single SQLite access point.
INSERT the match row, DPI/sens stamped from the active set if one matched.
games_on_stage += 1; set auto-retires (active=0) if this was its last needed game.
revalidateAll() fires — every mounted useApi hook refetches.
Stat cards, streaks and trends update in place with the new match.

flows.name: Pre-Match LLM Advisor
flows.description: Selecting a map triggers a data-grounded hero recommendation plus one LLM coaching sentence, cached 7 days per (map, queue_mode).

steps.label: Player picks a map / queue mode.
fetchRecommendation() calls the advisor endpoint.
GET /api/advisor/recommend — checks the 7-day cache first.
Cache hit: return cached insight + stretch pick immediately.
Cache miss: pull comfort pool, map context, and factual death axes live.
Claude Haiku 4.5 call, structured output constrained to {insight, stretch, stretch_untested}.
Write the fresh insight back to advisor_cache.
Renders primary/stretch hero picks and the grounded coaching sentence.

flows.name: DPI Stage-Trial Setup
flows.description: Sean creates a new DPI stage-trial set for a hero (or ad-hoc) with either hand-picked DPI values or an auto ±% spread — several sets can be active at once, one per hero.

steps.label: Configure sens, batch size, and either explicit DPI values or a base+range.
POST /api/blind/sets — refuses a duplicate active set for the same hero/slot.
generateStages() or stagesFromDpis() builds the ordered stage list.
BEGIN transaction — set insert and stage inserts land together or roll back.
New blind_stage_sets row (cur_rel=1) plus its blind_stages rows are committed.
GET /api/blind/state on the next poll shows the new set's HUD card, stage 1 live.

flows.name: Advance a DPI Stage
flows.description: Once a stage hits its game target, the player manually advances the set to the next DPI value.

steps.label: HUD shows needSwitch=true once games_on_stage >= batch_size.
POST /api/blind/advance {set_id} — refuses if already at the last stage.
getDb().
cur_rel += 1, games_on_stage reset to 0.
Next poll shows the new DPI value to dial into the mouse.

flows.name: Post-Match Aim Stats Backfill
flows.description: Matches carry sens/DPI at log time, but combat stats (accuracy, elims, damage...) are entered afterward from the in-game scoreboard via a pending queue.

steps.label: Pending tab: matches with sens logged but no aim_stats row yet.
GET /api/aim/pending?limit=40 — LEFT JOIN matches vs. aim_stats.
getDb().
Rows where sens IS NOT NULL and no matching aim_stats.match_id.
Player fills accuracy/elims/damage/duration from the OW scoreboard.
POST /api/aim — upsert keyed on match_id (re-submit corrects a prior entry).
INSERT ... ON CONFLICT(match_id) DO UPDATE.
revalidateAll() — the pending queue count and SensAnalysis both refresh.

flows.name: Sensitivity Analysis Aggregation
flows.description: The core research output: accuracy and win rate bucketed by physical cm/360 sensitivity, split by hitscan/projectile archetype and cold/warm session position.

steps.label: Page loads the full study result.
GET /api/aim/analysis.
getDb().
Full match timeline (session gaps, sens-run derivation).
JOIN matches for every row with logged accuracy.
cm360()/eDPI() convert sens+dpi to the physically comparable scale; archetypeOf() tags hitscan vs. projectile; deriveSessionPosition/Adaptation flag cold-start and post-DPI-change matches.
Bucket by rounded cm/360, absorbing thin legacy near-2.5-sens points into the nearest blind-trial bucket.
Renders byScale/byArchetype charts, cold-vs-warm and adaptation splits, per-hero best scale.

flows.name: Dashboard Stats Load
flows.description: Landing on the Dashboard fires five parallel stat queries plus the Trends factoid pool.

steps.label: Mounts and fires useApi() for overview, streaks, trends, mode-comparison, and the tilt banner.
GET /api/stats/{overview,streaks,trends,mode-comparison,prematch}.
getDb().
Aggregate SELECTs (COUNT/SUM/AVG, window functions for the rolling trend).
Renders StatCards, the rolling win-rate line, and the mode-comparison cards.
Separately loads the precomputed factoid pool.
GET /api/stats/insights — 7 independent statistical splits computed server-side.
JOINed in for the performance/crit/kill-secure splits.
Draws 4 random reliable factoids from the pool on every load.

flows.name: Hero / Map Drill-down with Death Insights
flows.description: Clicking a hero or map name anywhere opens its drawer with full stats and a death-pattern breakdown.

steps.label: Player clicks a hero or map name.
openHero(name) / openMap(name) sets the drawer's open target.
Drawer slides in, keyed on the open hero.
GET /api/stats/hero-detail/:hero.
getDb().
Overall/momentum/best-worst-maps/types + deathInsights() aggregation scoped to this hero.
Renders the profile.
Renders the reason breakdown and win/loss correlation panel.

flows.name: Edit or Delete a Logged Match
flows.description: Correcting a mistake in a previously logged match, or removing a bad row entirely.

steps.label: Player clicks a match row to correct or remove it.
openMatch(match) sets the edit target.
Drawer opens with the match's current fields.
PUT /api/matches/:id (partial field update) or DELETE /api/matches/:id.
getDb().
UPDATE the listed fields only, or DELETE the row.
revalidateAll() — every page's stats immediately reflect the correction.
